arms.A1: COUNTERFACTUAL_TRAINING, both candidate consequence distributions from same state
arms.A2: oracle-state evaluator pretrain, then bit-exact frozen head and observed CE
arms.A3: A2 through step 500, then gradual head unfreeze at 0.1 upstream LR

config.threshold_rationale: Frozen after both development seeds and their independent frozen evaluations. A0 TV was below 0.012, interaction and CFA near zero; functioning A1/A2/A3 generally had TV above 0.8, interaction above 1.3, CFA above 0.4 and BS above 0.55. Thresholds mark effects far above A0 noise without selecting a best development seed. Formation-window read clamps were documented before formal training. Formation state-zero was added only as POST_START_EXPLORATORY after the first formal A2 training completed and is excluded from G60.

outcome_category: A — shortcut corrected with replicated behavioral, exposure and peripheral evidence
